tools.name: search_cruises
tools.description: Search cruises sold to the UK market by destination, departure port, cruise line, ship, months or dates, length, budget, no-fly (UK departures) and ocean or river. Names or slugs both work, and anything we can't match comes back in not_understood. query takes free text ("a week in the fjords from So

tools.name: get_cruise
tools.description: One cruise in full: the day-by-day itinerary, every future sailing with its price (or why there isn't one) and a booking link, and its Cruisify page. Give the url of a Cruisify cruise page, as search_cruises returns it, or the cruise's slug.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Every destination we know, ocean or river, with how many upcoming cruises we hold for each and its Cruisify page where there is one.

tools.name: list_departure_ports
tools.description: The ports the cruises we hold leave from, with UK ports marked, how many upcoming cruises leave from each and its Cruisify page where there is one. Set uk_only for UK ports only (no-fly cruises).

tools.name: list_cruise_lines
tools.description: The cruise lines we cover and their ships, with how many upcoming cruises we hold for each and their Cruisify pages where there are some.
